explanation: Charles M. Schulz drew all of the nearly 18,000 Peanuts strips himself, from 1950 to 2000. Snoopy began as an ordinary four-legged dog and only later walked on two legs.

claims.text: Snoopy, in Peanuts, is a beagle.
Snoopy is not a dalmatian, a basset hound or a bull terrier.
Charles M. Schulz drew nearly 18,000 Peanuts strips himself, between October 1950 and February 2000.
In early Peanuts strips Snoopy walked on four legs like an ordinary dog, and he later took to walking upright on two legs.
